move: overlay panels wipe over photo, poster type rises, badge spins, ticker crawls
how: A portrait poster: an ocean photo doing a slow Ken Burns (scale 1.12 to 1.02, y -20 to 20, linear over the whole 4s) under three mix-blend-mode overlay panels: an orange full-bleed sheet that wipes in via scaleX from the left (expo.out, first 20%), a blue lower block that grows via scaleY from the bottom, and a white inset card that slides up from yPercent 110. Three headline lines 'Open / Water / Fest' rise out of clipped rows from yPercent 105 with expo.out and 0.1s stagger from 11%; a round 'Live Sept 12' badge pops from scale 0 with back.out(1.8) and then rotates 360deg linearly across the loop; a white ticker strip scales open and its track crawls x -880 linearly. From 84% the panels collapse back (expo.in), the headline shoots up, and badge, ticker and footer fade so the loop restarts on the bare photo.
adapt: Swap the background image, the three headline words, badge text, ticker string and footer meta; recolour the orange/blue panels. Keep the scaleX/scaleY wipes with expo.out and the 0.1s line stagger; the ticker distance (-880) must equal one repeat of the string width.
port: mount(el, shot) builds .img (from shot.image), the three .panel divs, badge, headline rows, strip and meta inside el; animate(el, shot, D) returns one gsap.timeline with the same tweens at fractions of D (wipes 0-0.2D, type 0.11D, exit 0.84D), with the Ken Burns, badge rotation and ticker as full-D linear tweens. Selectors scoped to el; the image URL becomes a shot parameter.
caveats: four overlay-blended layers over a full-frame photo are slow to composite
from() tweens need immediateRender:false if built after paint
